Match.title: Match
Match.description: A deterministic 2-to-4 player mythology trump card match with seat management, 2v2 team support, turn timers, and active player presence tracking.

matchId.description: Unique identifier of the match document.

hostUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the room host.

fillWithBots.description: Whether empty seats are automatically filled by deterministic bots on match start.

activePlayers.description: UIDs of players currently connected to the match session (max 4).

matchSeed.description: Deterministic Mulberry32 PRNG seed for deck shuffling, realm rotation, and leader choice.

maxRounds.description: Round cap (default 60) after which card counts decide the winner.

activeTurnIndex.description: 0-based seat index of the player whose turn it is.

activeRealm.description: Active mythological realm granting +15 bonus to matching domains.

players.description: Ordered seat roster (2-4 seats) holding decks, UID, ready/away status, team, and passive flags.

warPot.description: Card IDs held in the tie pot for the next round winner.

gambitArmed.description: True if the active turn player armed Gambit for the upcoming clash.

prophecyTarget.description: Chosen opponent prophecy target and revealed stat for the current round, or null.

statWins.description: Cumulative rounds won per stat key (might, arcana, cunning, influence).

bestWin.description: Highest effective value clash win recorded in this match, or null.

winner.description: Match outcome once finished, or NONE while ongoing.

lastOutcome.description: Summary of the most recently resolved clash round.

turnStartedAt.description: Server timestamp when the current turn started (for 20s timeout tracking).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the match lobby was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest match state update.

/matches/{matchId}.description: 2-4 player multiplayer rooms, match state, and presence metadata.
